plan.objective: Investigate how study time, previous academic evaluations (G1, G2), and absences relate to student final academic performance (G3).
plan.interpreted_goal: Analyze the relationship between final student performance (G3) and explanatory factors such as study time, previous term grades (G1 and G2), and absences using descriptive and bivariate statistical techniques.

selected_columns.reason: Primary target variable representing final student academic performance.
First period grade representing previous academic evaluation.
Second period grade representing previous academic evaluation.
Represents weekly study time input by the student.

analysis_tasks.task: Compute Summary Statistics for Target and Predictors
analysis_tasks.description: Calculate mean, standard deviation, median, and interquartile range for G3, G1, G2, studytime, and absences.
analysis_tasks.reason: To understand the central tendency and dispersion of the target and key predictors.
notes: Check for skewness or potential bounding issues in grade distributions.

analysis_tasks.description: Examine the frequency distribution and normality of G3 scores.
analysis_tasks.reason: Determines whether parametric or non-parametric correlation measures are best suited.

analysis_tasks.task: Correlation Analysis between Previous Grades and Final Performance
analysis_tasks.description: Compute correlation coefficients between G1, G2, and G3 to evaluate the strength and direction of linear association.
analysis_tasks.reason: Previous academic evaluations are strong predictors of final grade outcomes.
notes: Collinearity between G1 and G2 is expected.

analysis_tasks.task: Relationship between Study Time, Absences, and Final Grade (G3)
analysis_tasks.description: Evaluate the association of studytime and absences with G3 using correlation and scatter analysis.
analysis_tasks.reason: To test if higher study time and lower absences correlate with better final grades.
notes: Absences often exhibit high positive skewness.

analysis_tasks.task: Outlier Detection in Absences and Grades
analysis_tasks.description: Identify potential extreme values in absences, G1, G2, and G3 using IQR method.
analysis_tasks.reason: Extreme absence counts or zero-grade values may disproportionately influence correlations.
notes: Do not remove outliers automatically; flag them for analytical awareness.
